title: Château Laurier

geometryLabel: Combined hotel, roof facets, low central halls and entrance porticos; neighboring canal-side structure excluded.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap; individually inspected local photographs; NCC phase study and ERA/architectsAlliance existing elevations in Ottawa heritage-impact report.
notes: Mapped roof ridges 39/45 m and tallest octagonal roof 64 m agree approximately with the existing hotel shown beside dimensioned proposed additions in 2020 drawing A_2.3. limitations: Eaves, floor spacing, roof junctions and ornamental details are interpreted from photographs and existing elevation depictions.
The lower central halls occupy the U; this is not an empty courtyard at ground level.
